description: This file defines a factory class 'DefaultHttpRequestActorPropsFactory' responsible for creating Props objects for HTTP request actors within an Akka-based system. It implements the HttpRequestActorPropsFactory interface and provides a method to generate actor Props with specified parameters, facilitating the creation and configuration of HTTP request actors.

classes.name: DefaultHttpRequestActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A final class serving as a factory for creating Props objects for Akka HTTP request actors, implementing the HttpRequestActorPropsFactory interface.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object configured for the specified HTTP request actor, using provided actor reference, header translator, HTTP request, response future, and configuration objects.
